subject: Proposal: transition Lyra Health renewal to AWS Marketplace billing
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@lyrahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 26 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: transition Lyra Health renewal to AWS Marketplace billing

Hi Samantha —

Hope you had a good weekend. As Lyra's renewal is approaching (Nov 15), I wanted to propose moving the subscription to AWS Marketplace invoicing for the upcoming term. We’ve seen this simplify procurement for several healthcare customers and unlock co-sell credits on the AWS side. The key benefits for Lyra:

- Single invoice through your AWS billing (no separate vendor POs)
- Faster procurement approvals for cloud teams
- Ability to reuse committed spend for marketplace discounts in future deals

Attached is a short mutual action plan (MAP) that outlines required steps and timing. High-level ask: Can you confirm whether procurement would prefer an AWS Marketplace SKU (metered/annual) or a sponsored procurement path? If you’re open, Ben (copied) can join to run through commercial tradeoffs and any co-sell incentives.

Suggested next step: 30-minute call this week to align on timeline and the exact billing SKU we should publish. I can share the onboarding checklist and a draft amendment for your legal team.

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Lyra_Marketplace_Migration_MAP.xlsx (spreadsheet), RINF-AWS-Marketplace-Onboarding-Checklist.pdf (one-pager)
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@lyrahealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mark Chen <mark.chen@lyrahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: transition Lyra Health renewal to AWS Marketplace billing

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the note and the MAP. Moving to Marketplace could help speed approvals on our side, but a few procurement questions before we proceed:

1) Would the Marketplace flow require a new contract/amendment or just an invoicing change?
2) We need to confirm tax and remittance details — do you have standard tax forms for the Marketplace SKU?
3) Our finance lead wants to understand if committing on Marketplace changes the renewal pricing cadence.

I’m looping in Mark (Finance). We can do a quick call Wednesday or Thursday morning PT. On paper, we’d prefer an annual SKU with invoicing routed through our AWS account; curious what incentives are available for co-sell and whether Redwood will provide any transition credit for moving before renewal.

Best,
Samantha Ortiz
Head of Procurement, Lyra Health
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@lyrahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: transition Lyra Health renewal to AWS Marketplace billing

Samantha —

Great questions — quick answers below and I’ll cover the details on the call:

1) Contract: Practically we do a short amendment that references the existing MSA and points billing to the AWS Marketplace SKU. I’ve attached a draft amendment for legal review (we keep it minimal).
2) Tax/remittance: Marketplace invoicing uses AWS tax handling in most scenarios; we provide the SKU and seller-of-record info. I’ve attached our onboarding checklist which lists required tax forms if your tax team needs them.
3) Pricing cadence: The annual SKU locks pricing for the term you select (standard Marketplace behavior). Any future changes would be handled via amendment or a new SKU.

On transition credits: We can offer a modest early-adoption credit that offsets the first invoice month if Lyra commits to the Marketplace SKU now; Ben will propose the credit level and co-sell motion.

Can you do Wed 29 Sep at 09:30 PT? If yes, I’ll send a calendar invite and Ben will prepare a short commercial summary. Priyom (on the infra team) is cc’d to address any technical onboarding questions about entitlement syncing and metering.

Thanks —
Rachel
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@lyrahealth.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: transition Lyra Health renewal to AWS Marketplace billing

On Wed, Sep 29, 2027 at 09:04 AM Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@lyrahealth.com> wrote:
> Can you do Wed 29 Sep at 09:30 PT?

Thanks for the quick turnaround — appreciate the details, Rachel. Lyra team — great to meet you virtually. A couple quick commercial notes ahead of our call:

- Recommended path: publish an annual SKU (non-metered) that maps to your current renewal spend. That keeps forecasting simple for Lyra and lets you consume via your AWS billing account.
- Transition incentive: Redwood can provide a one-time credit equal to 10% of the first-year subscription, applied to the first invoice, conditional on a signed amendment and confirmed AWS account entitlement mapping.
- Co-sell: We will register the opportunity in the AWS co-sell pipeline. If accepted, Lyra becomes visible to AWS sellers which can accelerate deployments and potential joint GTM.

Please review the attached commercial summary (I’ll upload to the invite). See you in a few minutes.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Mark Chen <mark.chen@lyrahealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: transition Lyra Health renewal to AWS Marketplace billing

Rachel/Ben —

Thanks for the call. Follow ups from our side:

- Finance needs the exact SKU and the seller-of-record EIN for our AP system.
- We will need a PO generated against the Marketplace invoice; please confirm the invoice delivery address and remittance instructions.
- Legal asked for a one-paragraph amendment rather than a multi-page doc; they prefer minimal changes that keep the existing MSA intact.

I’m attaching our standard purchasing form (we will fill it once we have the SKU and EIN). If you can provide those two items today, we’ll start our internal approval and aim to complete the transition by Nov 1 so billing hits Marketplace for the renewal.

Thanks —
Mark Chen
Senior Director, Finance — Lyra Health

Attachments referenced: Lyra_Purchase_Form.xlsx
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: transition Lyra Health renewal to AWS Marketplace billing

Mark/Samantha —

Thanks — all good. Action items below and I’ve attached the short one-paragraph amendment (2027-09-29-Lyra-Amendment-terms.docx) as requested:

Action items:
- Rachel/Redwood: provide SKU identifier and seller EIN (by end of day) — DONE. SKU: RINF-LH-ANNUAL-2027. Seller EIN: 12-3456789.
- Lyra: complete PO using your Purchase Form and send to ap@redwood.ai; confirm AWS account ID for entitlement mapping.
- Legal: review attached one-paragraph amendment and return any redlines to legal@redwood.ai.
- Priyom: will coordinate entitlement sync and provide the entitlement mapping guide (cc’d).

I’ve also uploaded the DocuSign link for execution and the HubSpot deal is updated with the migration plan. If Lyra signs the amendment this week and sends the PO, we’ll aim to flip billing to AWS Marketplace by Nov 1 and apply the agreed 10% transition credit to your first invoice.

Meeting notes and next steps are in the MAP attachment. Let me know if you want me or Ben to run a short internal walkthrough for Finance or Legal.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
